visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with neatly styled black hair, wearing a light blue and white vertical striped shirt over a white crew-neck T-shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a bright indoor studio. He uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize his words, appearing energetic and friendly. The background features a neutral-toned wall with a subtle geometric pattern, and the lighting is even and bright, highlighting his facial features. (2) The scene abruptly cuts to the same man wearing a light brown plush bear-ear headband. His entire face is covered in a white cream mask, with black paint around his eyes and nose, and a red mouth to resemble a dog's face. He holds a large white Samoyed dog with a thick coat and its tongue out, posing together for the camera in the same indoor setting. (3) The man begins cleaning his face using a transparent blue bottle of Nivea Micellar Water. He applies the liquid to a square white cotton pad and wipes away the painted dog muzzle and nose. Close-up shots show the black and red pigments transferring easily to the pad, revealing clean and healthy skin underneath without any visible irritation. (4) A product showcase displays three distinct variations of the Nivea Micellar Water: the blue (Refreshing) bottle, the pink (Caring) bottle, and the purple (Soothing) bottle. They are lined up on a flat surface, and the man's hands point to each one as informative text overlays appear on the screen to explain their specific skin-type benefits. (5) The man is shown with a completely clean and bare face, smiling broadly and poking his cheeks with his index fingers to demonstrate skin hydration and elasticity. His skin looks smooth, matte, and refreshed. He continues to speak enthusiastically while holding the blue micellar water bottle close to his face. (6) The video concludes with the man holding all three bottles of the product, summarizing his recommendation. He maintains high energy and direct eye contact with the camera, gesturing towards the products and the viewer in the same brightly lit indoor environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male speaker delivering energetic Mandarin narration over an upbeat, electronic-pop background music track. The BGM has a steady 120 BPM tempo with a prominent kick drum and bright synthesizer pads in a major key, creating a positive, commercial atmosphere. (2) A sharp, high-pitched cartoon 'boing' sound effect triggers a transition, momentarily contrasting with the steady rhythm. The male voice continues with an exaggerated, comedic tone to match the visual change, while the BGM maintains its consistent energetic beat and volume level. (3) The speaker shifts to an informative and enthusiastic tone, detailing product features. The BGM persists as a rhythmic floor, and a subtle 'pop' sound effect is heard when a product bottle is shown. The voice quality is clear and professional with no ambient noise interference. (4) Subtle liquid wiping sounds and soft frictional noises are audible as the speaker demonstrates the cleansing process. These sound effects are mixed clearly above the BGM but below the primary narration. The speaker's pitch remains moderate with dynamic intonations to maintain viewer engagement. (5) The final phase features a summary by the male speaker with a friendly and persuasive tone. The electronic-pop BGM continues at its original tempo and volume, providing a cohesive rhythmic conclusion. The articulation remains sharp and well-enunciated until the audio resolves on the final chord.
